summary: Bernice Moorehead reported missing; El Paso County Sheriff's Office Mounted Unit, detectives, and El Paso County Search and Rescue conducted a coordinated search along Fountain Creek near Pinello Ranch after personal belongings believed to be hers were found in the area; skeletal remains were found just north of Pinello Ranch, believed to be Moorehead
responding_agency: El Paso County Sheriff's Office (Mounted Unit) / El Paso County Search and Rescue
notes: Date is the sheriff's media-release date (release says 'Today' for the search; search-index crawl metadata dates the release 2024-10-17, the same day she was reported missing). Coroner to confirm identity and cause/manner of death.
